clauses.clause_label: Proprietary License — reserved rights and express restrictions
clauses.scope_note: The restriction applies to the repository software or any part of it, for any purpose. The text says viewing or cloning does not grant these rights; it does not grant broader rights by implication.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed activities are prohibited absent prior written permission from the copyright holder. The predicate means that such permission has not been obtained; no permission is presumed.

coverage_notes: The text says the repository and its contents are publicly viewable for portfolio, demonstration, and code-review purposes, but none of the allowed activities represents viewing, so that statement is not extracted as an activity clause.

The restriction lists specific acts; it does not establish a blanket prohibition on unlisted activities such as training, hosting, or network service. No permission for those activities is supplied, so they remain unspecified.
Warranty and liability disclaimers and the permission-request contact instruction are omitted as unrelated to the requested activities.
